notes: Adds the Strategy tab for user-defined EMA, RSI or MACD entry rules, exits, account protection, candle checks, review and explicit demo activation. Markets contains pair configurations.
Custom strategy execution requires connector 0.8.47 and a paired USD hedging demo account. Legacy strategy entry routes are retired; existing positions retain captured management.
Fixes saved pair settings reverting after navigation and improves new-account synchronization, broker-symbol matching and recovery after app restarts.
Home displays separate technical, optional AI and calendar states so passing indicators are not mistaken for complete execution approval.
Removes obsolete Market analysis and Level 2 panels from Markets while preserving pair settings and navigation.

Fixes incorrect cached phone-clock estimates that made healthy connector and watchdog reports appear stale. Independently verifies time and automatically rechecks after reconnects or suspicious timestamps.
Keeps quote, account, broker, margin and saved risk checks unchanged. Display-clock recovery does not authorize orders or reset loss controls.
Updating preserves saved settings and does not activate a strategy, start a connector or grant live trading permission. Actual fills and fees can exceed intended exit triggers.
